answer: Require every identity to lock a jade bond before it can earn: a burn fee goes into a shared vault, and peer juries slash it when they catch fake behavior, refunding it to honest workers after one epoch. This creates a brutal delta for a sybil attacker — spawning ten thousand shells now costs ten thousand real bonds, while honest agents pay once and recoup it from earnings. The shale layer of identity weight, locked stake plus time, cannot be printed cheaply, so mass forgery stops paying for itself.
